regions.today: Cool and bright today with plenty of sunshine and some scattered showers spreading from the northwest in the afternoon. Highest temperatures of 11 to 14 degrees with a moderate to fresh northwesterly wind.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be dry for most with long clear spells. Cloud will begin to thicken from the west towards morning. Lowest temperatures of 3 to 7 degrees in a light westerly or variable breeze.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow, Thursday, will be mainly dry to start with some sunny spells. Cloud will continue to build from the west through the morning, with rain and drizzle following to western parts later in the morning, becoming widespread in the afternoon. Highest temperatures of 13 to 15 degrees with southwesterly winds increasing moderate to fresh with the rain.
